description: This PHP class 'HelpController' is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Help module's Controller namespace. It manages help-related requests by validating URLs and redirecting accordingly, leveraging a HelpService for business logic. The class extends an abstract Vue controller and handles exceptions related to request forwarding.

classes.name: HelpController
classes.description: Controller class handling help page URL validation and redirection within the OrangeHRM Help module.

methods.name: getHelpService
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an instance of HelpService used for URL validation and redirect URL retrieval.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests by checking URL validity and redirecting to appropriate help documentation or default page, handling exceptions as needed.
